alloy.preparation: Supplied as hot-forged rods, 18-mm diameter. Quenched condition indicated in the Figure 2/3 labels: heated in air at 1120°C for 1 h, then water-quenched. Further specimen preparation and experimental details are referred elsewhere and are not provided in the supplied paper.
alloy.microstructure: Austenite with a small amount of δ-ferrite; small carbide (Me23C6) and carbonitride (Me2(C,N)) precipitates; pure nitrides very rare. No sigma phase detected by X-ray analysis. Quenching caused some homogenization and precipitate coagulation, without significant phase-composition change.

test_method.procedure_description: Figure 2 potentiokinetic pit-nucleation series, with the polarization progression printed as 50 mV/30 sec in Figure 1. The paper does not separately define a potential-step/hold program; no such settings are inferred. The 2 V/h protocol belongs to additional passivation measurements and is not substituted. Hydrogen-electrode (NHE) potential scale.
test_method.pitting_criterion: E′np: rise of apparent anodic current density as a consequence of pitting, distinct from passive current and critical passivation parameters.

experiments.result_note: Potentiokinetic pit-nucleation potential E′np; approximate marker reading. Axis mV_H; text identifies the hydrogen-electrode scale as NHE. Table 1 reports composition in percent without an explicit mass/atomic basis; the printed % unit is retained. Solution normalities are not converted into molarity or calculated chloride concentration/pH. Surface preparation, aeration and solvent are not supplied here.
